summary: Preserve bounded factual source projections, exact resort identities, complete per-winter captures and uncertainty-aware local decisions across CLI and MCP.
reason: SnowJapan publishes Wix SSR and changing source-owned chart embeddings rather than REST JSON. Generic HTML passthrough loses facts and exposes editorial prose; unscoped cache absence and shared operating-unit URLs must not imply closure.
validated_outcome: Live source projections and independent CLI/MCP checks cover stable identities, historical units, explicit unsynced winters, numeric null/zero semantics and read-only local planners.
